name: Cohere Rerank v3.5
notes:
Cohere ships rerank-v3.5 as a closed API; the HF repo Cohere/Cohere-Rerank-v3.5 contains no config.json with transformer geometry. The KV-geometry fields are left null rather than guessed. RERANKER: cross-encoder. Context length 4096 tokens (query+document combined). Supports same languages as embed-multilingual-v3.0. Not open weights — available via Cohere API and AWS Bedrock. No config.json available on HF (only tokenizer). Architecture details not publicly specified. The 4096-token context limit is the serving-relevant fact.

CONTEXT_SCALING_METHOD (null): proprietary API; record's own attention_variant is 'architecture not specified', so no positional scheme is established either way.
